args.result:
Created `src/core/tools/GetWorkspaceFileCountTool.ts` following the exact same pattern as GetGitStatusTool.ts and GetWorkspacePulseTool.ts.

The tool:
- Extends `BaseTool<"get_workspace_file_count">`
- Has `readonly name = "get_workspace_file_count" as const`
- Accepts params `{ extensions?: string[] }` (normalizes extensions to include a leading dot)
- In `execute`, uses `require("fs")` and `require("path")` to recursively count files in `task.cwd`, skipping `node_modules` and `.git` directories
- Filters by extension when `extensions` is provided
- Pushes results like `"File count: 42 (filtered by: .ts, .tsx)"` or `"File count: 156 (all files)"`
- Wraps logic in try/catch, pushing `"Failed to count workspace files: ..."` on error
- Has a no-op `handlePartial` override
- Exports a singleton `getWorkspaceFileCountTool`
